correctness.rationale: X_m=Ind(KG(3,m−6)) for m>=6. Every six-support induces a join of ten S0 factors, a 9-sphere. The explicit ten pairwise intersecting triple-facet has no 2-vertex transversal and is globally maximal, so its indicator 9-cochain is closed and evaluates as δST on the six-support 9-cycles; this is an integral left inverse, giving a primitive injection. Feng 2026 §6 provides the independent exact rational rank binom(m,6), making those generators a rational basis. For a six-label transposition the ten-dimensional anti-complement coordinate representation has trace (8−0)/2=4, three -1 eigenvalues and hence determinant -1; every six-support stabilizer acts by sign. Therefore the S_m module is exactly ∧6 Q^m and the integral primitive image is ∧6 Z^m. Cycle determinant, hook decomposition and rational subgroup quotient averaging follow. No integral torsion-freeness or equivariant integral direct-summand splitting is asserted.
